buildServer.repoPath: (none: source is sent per build with git archive)
buildServer.note: Godot project, same Mac and pipeline as wildbound. No git remote: commit locally (workflow direct, no push), then buildCommand runs on THIS box: it sends `git archive HEAD` to a temp dir on the Mac, copies the EAS signing credentials (eas/credentials.json, gitignored) into a throwaway keychain there, runs the Godot export + xcodebuild detached with polling, and copies the ipa back to dist/ios/. Skip the skill's push/pull/SSH/poll/scp steps.

submit.command: IPA=$(realpath {ipa}) && cd eas && npx eas-cli@24.10.0 submit -p ios --profile production --path "$IPA" --non-interactive
submit.afterSuccess: Write the submitted build number into ios/build-number.txt (the ipa name is HuntSurvivors-<version>-<build>.ipa) and commit it with the release-log entry. Or run scripts/ship-ios-godot.sh without --no-submit, which builds, submits and bumps the file in one go.
